name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 14, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Alex Aguas of Oak Hills Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring May 19-25, 2013 "Public Works Week" in the City of Vista
P2.
Presentation of the "People's Choice Winner" for the New Dimensions Art Exhibit
P3.
Presentation by Representatives of the 2013 San Diego County Fair
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending March 31, 2013 (CC)
C4.
Final Subdivision Map at 2495 San Clemente Avenue (CC)
C5.
CalRecycle Oil Payment Program 3 Grant Award (CC)
C6.
Extension of Sprint Encroachment Agreement (CC)
C7.
Application for Cabaret License - Art Beat on Main Street, LLC, located at 330 Main Street (CC)
C8.
Urban Search and Rescue Task Force Memorandum of Agreement (CC)
C9.
Traffic Signal/Safety Lighting Maintenance Services Agreement (CC)
C10.
Purchase of Vacuum/Jet Rodder Unit (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the purchase of a Vacuum/Rodder unit;
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2013- , approving the purchase of a Vacuum/Jet Rodder unit; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Membership Agreement for cooperative purchasing with National Joint Powers Alliance (NJPA).
C11.
Senior Nutrition Center Meal Agreements (CC)
C12.
Engineer's Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2013/14 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista Landscape and Lighting District No. 1 assessments for FY 2013/14, and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , determining the cost of services and the amount of assessment to be imposed on all assessable property within the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1 for FY 2013/14 pursuant to the Benefit Assessment Act of 1982.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving an Engineer's Report on the City of Vista South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District assessments for the FY 2013/14, and declaring its intent to levy and collect assessments.
C13.
North County Branding Program (CC)
C14.
Purchase of Network Switches (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Second Reading of Ordinance to Amend the Vista Development Code to Reflect the Current Standards for Public Works Construction (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the adoption of a City Council Ordinance amending Chapter 16.04 of the Vista Development Code to reflect current Standards for Public Works Construction by reference.
2.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013-7, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 16.04 of the Vista Development Code by Adopting the 2012 Edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, and the September 2012 Edition of the San Diego Regional Standard Drawings Including Indices and Appendices by Reference with Additions and Amendments."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
